principle: Score, UI, Today, and Command Centre MUST converge from evidence_authority.state via map_authority_to_scoring_status and governance_family policy.

score_authority_modes_by_family.SELF_CERTIFIED: Governance guard closure → VERIFIED_CURRENT; partial → NEEDS_REVIEW until complete
score_authority_modes_by_family.ORG_ADMIN_REVIEWED: Declaration recorded → NEEDS_REVIEW until org verify or auto-accept policy
score_authority_modes_by_family.ESCALATION_REVIEW_ONLY: Escalated → NEEDS_REVIEW until platform escalation resolved

divergence_prevention: Ban frontend score-adjacent labels that imply VALID when authority is NEEDS_REVIEW
Today hero counts use same map_authority_to_scoring_status
Command Centre task severity derives from authority + governance_family stale rules
